adoption_and_training_decision.weight_adoption_rule: Do not adopt a warm checkpoint from improved retrieval or token accuracy alone. Require matched random and no-transfer arms, per-group tensor movement, and native state-verifier success on the same release.
adoption_and_training_decision.deployment_rule: A WebGPU action may be emitted only after the interaction policy classifies it as allowed, confirmation-required, clarification-required, or blocked; the static demo executes none of these external effects.
